card.name: Decimal points inside percentages and titles

modes.label: Decimal point in percentages
modes.description: The period between digits of a percentage in a results table, just before the next digit.

modes.label: 'the' in work titles
modes.description: The word 'the' inside a book or episode title, after 'and' or a quote mark.

modes.label: Digit in numbers
modes.description: A leading digit in a serial number or percentage count.

card.plain: It fires on the dot inside numbers like 15.8% and on 'the' in titles, in table-like or reference text.
